question: Arjun and Malaika have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Arjun is driving at 138 km/hr while Malaika is driving at 92 km/hr. Find the time taken by Malaika to reach Kanpur if Arjun takes 8 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of speeds of Arjun and Malaika = 138 : 92 = 3 : 2

Since the distance is constant, the time taken is inversely proportional to the speed.

Ratio of time taken by Arjun and Malaika = 2 : 3

Time taken by Arjun (2 units) = 8 hours ⇒ 1 unit = 4 hours.

Time taken by Malaika (3 units) = 3 × 4 = 12 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Arjun (S₁) = 138 km/hr

Time taken by Arjun (T₁) = 8 hours

Speed of Malaika (S₂) = 92 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

When Distance is constant, S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 138 × 8 = 1104 km

Let the time taken by Malaika be T₂.

⇒ T₂ = Distance ÷ Speed of Malaika

⇒ T₂ = 1104 ÷ 92

⇒ T₂ = 12 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

If equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y). For different distances covered in different times, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Proportionality in Speed, Time and Distance

If Distance is constant, Speed is inversely proportional to Time (S₁ ÷ S₂ = T₂ ÷ T₁). If Time is constant, Distance is directly proportional to Speed.
